title: Grassification D2.3.1 roadside-grass press-juice characterization reference dataset
description: Selected measurements transcribed from Tables 1 and 3–5 of the public Grassification Deliverable D2.3.1. Two roadside-grass pressing sessions (Utrecht, November 2018; Maldegem, June 2019) report fresh-mass liquid/fibre yields and liquid properties including pH, conductivity, total solids, density, TOC, and Kjeldahl-derived crude protein.
source_title: D2.3.1 Assessment of the potential of protein extraction and protein production (insects and microalgae) from the liquid fraction
authors: Jappe de Best (editor); Audrey Miserez; Marcella Fernandes de Souza
geography: Utrecht municipality roadside highway, Netherlands (autumn 2018); Maldegem municipality, Belgium (spring 2019)
source_location: Tables 1, 3, 4, and 5; PDF pages 5–7; document version 2.0
license: No explicit reuse license identified in the public deliverable; retain attribution and verify reuse terms before redistribution beyond this factual research transcription.
applicability: Direct roadside-grass press-juice measurements from two European mowing sessions. Utrecht session is geographically relevant to the Netherlands but not confirmed to be GreenHub feed. Maldegem is a Belgian roadside-grass analogue.
conversion_and_scaling: Values transcribed without scaling except numeric_value is parsed from the reported value string for machine use. Reported percentages are on fresh-feed mass basis; juice concentrations retain source units and as-received basis. No uncertainty type is inferred where the report does not identify it.
uncertainty: The deliverable reports two sessions only, with no site replication structure, no complete component mass balance, and unspecified statistics for several ± values. Table 1 session 1 liquid and fibre fractions sum to 100.2%; no normalization was applied. The authors note that Kjeldahl nitrogen in the solid fraction may derive from ammonium salts rather than protein. Session 2 juice was left at room temperature for the first hours after pressing and may have undergone fermentation.
provenance_note: This file is a selected factual transcription of published tabular measurements; it is not a recalibrated model input or a GreenHub process balance.
